name: English
reply: The person speaks English. Answer in English.
agent_rules: Answer in English, in one or two spoken sentences, with no markdown, lists, or emoji. Remember dates, places, and lists they ask you to keep. Look up a fact when it is not in the sentence. Do not claim you changed the computer.

ui.about.title: About
ui.about.lead: Each order below can be spoken. Most start with command. The example is a full phrase.
ui.about.body:
Grok Assistant listens at home. The audio stays here. Grok only receives the text of a question or an order, and only when the rules allow it. Everything else stays in the notebook on this computer.

This window is the log: what was heard, and what happened next. Closing it hides the program. The Grok icon in the tray opens it again. Quit closes it.
ui.market.hint: Nothing downloads by itself. It can be chosen once the download reaches 100%.
ui.window.debug: Debug — what was heard, and what happened next
ui.flow.caption: Audio stops at the listening engine. Grok only receives text.
ui.flow.no: No. The local model reads it.
ui.flow.test: Test. It writes and does nothing.

ui.offer.windows.title: Windows
ui.offer.windows.detail: Desktop dictation. The button installs it if it is missing.
ui.offer.kroko.title: Kroko
ui.offer.kroko.detail: Streaming STT engine for Spanish phrases. It hears while you speak.
ui.offer.whisper.title: Whisper tiny
ui.offer.whisper.detail: Local recognition, tiny model. Faster, less precise.
ui.offer.base.title: Whisper base
ui.offer.base.detail: Same engine, base model. Slower, and it usually hears better.
ui.offer.canary.title: Canary
ui.offer.canary.detail: Ear for Spanish, English, French, and German. A phrase closes after the silence.
ui.offer.small.title: Whisper small
ui.offer.small.detail: Same speech engine as Whisper tiny, small model. Clearer, and heavier.
ui.offer.zipfr.title: Zipformer French
ui.offer.zipfr.detail: Streaming ear for French only. It hears while you speak.
ui.offer.zipen.title: Zipformer English
ui.offer.zipen.detail: Streaming ear for English only, the small model. It hears while you speak.
ui.offer.cohere.title: Cohere
ui.offer.cohere.detail: Ear for 14 languages, including English, French, German, and Spanish. It uses the selected language.
ui.offer.llm.detail: Checks whether the phrase is a command. If it is not, the text goes on to Grok.
ui.offer.voice.detail: Piper voice. Shown only when the language matches.

screen_help: start: hello grok. stop: thanks or okay. Commands start with the word command.

help.title: Start talking
help.body: Outside a conversation the microphone hears and sends nothing. A greeting opens the chat. A question in the same breath is sent. A greeting alone stays open for two seconds in case the question follows.

help.title: Ask
help.body: With the conversation open, a sentence that is not a command is sent as text. The audio stays on this machine.

help.title: Stop
help.body: thanks, okay, goodbye and close end the chat here, with no cloud call.

help.title: Commands
help.body: Most orders start with the word command. One misheard letter still matches.

help.title: Volume
help.body: Turns the assistant volume up or down by five and says the new percent.

help.title: Voices
help.body: next voice moves to the next installed voice. voice and a number picks that voice.

help.title: Listening engine (STT)
help.body: Picks the speech-to-text engine. Keyboard types in this window. Whisper base reads other languages. The Spanish streaming engine keeps the audio on this PC. Whisper small, Cohere, and the French and English Zipformers are in the market. A Zipformer is picked on its own only in its language.

help.title: Song
help.body: Asks for a song by title. The first time it downloads the player. No account.

help.title: Music
help.body: Pause, resume, or stop the song that is playing.

help.title: Personality
help.body: Personality loads a person. Sliders change the numbers. The behavior box is free text. Restore puts the original numbers and text back.

help.title: Greetings
help.body: Under Voice, Greetings checks the kind and the theme of the startup line, the hello after a long gap, and the line while Grok searches. The lines are already stored. Saying them does not use the internet.

help.title: Language
help.body: Language switches the commands, the help, and the personalities. A new language is a json file in the lang folder.

help.title: Test
help.body: Test mode writes what the ear heard and runs nothing. Say exit to leave.

help.title: Voice print
help.body: One recording saves sixteen phrases. A high beep opens each phrase and a lower one closes it. A short pause leaves the phrase open. The listening engine does not decide whether the phrase was the expected one. The raw sound is kept. That sound builds one print for every listening engine, and each engine is scored because the phrases are known. The prints menu shows that person's hit rate beside the engine, for example (92%). It is information. At startup the program adds every print, keeps the highest engine, and writes the choice on Debug. Change the engine under Listen. The same person is not stored twice. A new engine is scored later from the saved sound.

alex.name: Alex
alex.label: intelligent colleague
alex.meaning: A capable colleague. Clear, lightly warm, a little humor. For everyday talk and technical work.
alex.behavior: Speak like a capable colleague. Clear, no textbook tone. Admit doubt. Light humor only when it fits.

vega.name: Vega
vega.label: elegant analyst
vega.meaning: Calm and precise. Evidence over enthusiasm. Dry humor, rarely.
vega.behavior: Split the problem into parts. Be concise. Prefer evidence. Humor is dry and rare.

nico.name: Nico
nico.label: trusted mate
nico.meaning: A sharp friend. Colloquial, and precise when the topic gets serious.
nico.behavior: Be spontaneous. Colloquial language and natural humor are fine. When the topic is serious, drop the humor and be precise.

lucia.name: Lucia
lucia.label: curious explorer
lucia.meaning: Connects ideas and, now and then, adds one useful curiosity. Does not wander off to show off.
lucia.behavior: Make useful connections. Add context only when it helps. A curiosity sometimes, never every answer, and never if it leaves the question.

marcos.name: Marcos
marcos.label: pragmatic architect
marcos.meaning: Questions complexity that is not needed. Looks at maintenance, cost, and how it fails.
marcos.behavior: Question complexity that is not needed. Talk about maintenance, cost, and failure. Prefer boring technology when it solves the problem.

ines.name: Ines
ines.label: the teacher
ines.meaning: Explains hard things without making anyone feel slow. Intuition and an example first.
ines.behavior: Do not treat a question as stupidity. Start with the intuition and one concrete example. A technical term only when it helps.

bruno.name: Bruno
bruno.label: observational humorist
bruno.meaning: Notices everyday absurdity. Humor almost disappears when the topic hurts.
bruno.behavior: Observational humor. Do not explain the joke and do not laugh at the person. If the topic hurts, the humor disappears.

carmen.name: Carmen
carmen.label: professional with character
carmen.meaning: Polished, never corporate. States a disagreement and offers another way.
carmen.behavior: State disagreement clearly, without diplomatic filler. Do not criticize without another option.
